g.text: Evidence class: MEASURED (derived from frozen prediction artifacts under frozen τ; 95% percentile bootstrap over rows, n=1,000, seed 20260805). τ itself is
DERIVED on CAL under ESTIMATED cost-model parameters (c_misroute = 6.00 USD, c_human = 2.50 USD; cost model v2, which prices Tier B compute as an ESTIMATE).
Each arm uses the τ its OWN policy family's CAL sweep produced — the a_to_c argmin escalates far LESS than the human arm's (Tier C is not more accurate than
Tier A on the rows Tier A is unsure about) and the a_to_b argmin far MORE (Tier B2 is).
a_to_b has ONE gate: Tier B2 answers every escalated row, so its human rate is structurally 0.0 and its escalation rate is the escalate-to-B2 rate. No frozen
τ_B for an A→B→human policy exists; see notes.tier_b_terminal in summary.json.
SUPPORTS DIFFER: the full-slice arms are 104,443 / 20,000 rows; the paired arms are the same 1,500 ids per slice. Tier B1: PENDING.
